answer: Sponsors are capped at 4 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 66 POA until the newcomer survives 16 clean epochs, and a farm of 620 fakes must find 620 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. A vine of doubt is healthy, a voyage of proof is required, and a shale of patience is the price of a clean panel.
